answer: This March 16 Style Lights Progress Report from J.J. Buxton to R.H. Orcutt shows strong distribution performance, with 82.2% in classified calls and 91.0% in annual calls. Advertising efforts, particularly outdoor ads and billboards, have effectively increased consumer awareness in markets where implemented. This is page 1 of a 4-page report.
